name: Minami Yuunagi
source: Katsuki's wife.  She was originally assigned to watch him and Mutsuki by the Houjou, but by nature she was unsuited to be a spy and fell in love with Katsuki.  Her loyalties currently lie with her new family.  She is perhaps the most un-Hunter-like Hunter in the entire story.
